caption: The drawing depicts a wooden roll-top desk with slender, turned legs and a variety of compartments. The main body of the desk is rectangular with curved roll-top sides, and it has a warm brown color indicating a wood finish. At the top, there are two horizontal drawers, each with a round metal pull handle. Below these, within the roll-top section, there are six vertical pigeonholes for organizing papers, flanked by two small drawers on each end, also with round handles. The writing surface is pulled out, providing a flat workspace, and is supported by two wooden pull-outs, each ending in a round knob. Beneath the writing area, there are additional drawers on both the left and right sides; the left stack contains two drawers and a keyhole, while the right stack has two drawers, each with a round handle. The legs are evenly spaced and smoothly tapered, ending in rounded feet. The desk is rendered against a plain, light-colored background, and no other objects are present in the drawing.
title: Roll-top Desk
